analyst_view.overall: NEC (12th, 7 points) and Rennes (17th, 6 points) are both inside the play-off places and a win would push either toward the top eight. NEC beat Omonia 3-1 last time out in Europe but lost centre-back Perr Schuurs early in that game, and Bram Nuytinck and Philippe Sandler have also been out, so their defence is thin. Rennes are three without a win (2-5 at Nice, 1-2 v Lille, 1-1 at Lorient on Sunday), Franck Haise is under open pressure from the owners, captain Valentin Rongier went off injured at Lorient and striker Eliezer Mayenda was absent; none of this is on the numbers' list. No match preview or referee was out yet, so this rests on the latest club news, which was thin on NEC.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals, a high figure for two open sides. NEC's depleted centre-backs point up, while Rennes missing Mayenda and possibly Rongier point down; these roughly cancel, so I stay at 3.8.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners, already trimmed for Rennes's lower recent corner count. Nothing new on style or lineups points either way, so I stay at 9.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards with both sides near their usual counts. Rennes's poor run and Haise's situation could add some edge, but that is a hunch and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.5 shots, already up about 8% for NEC's busy recent shooting (105 in six). Rennes's absences in attack and NEC's at the back pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 29.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target, already raised for NEC's 40 on target in their last six. Boulaye Dia is still scoring for Rennes even without Mayenda, so nothing moves this; I stay at 10.8.
